// USAGE: Copy the PostToolUse section into your settings.json hooks. The matcher is the tool name (Edit|Write); the command guards on extension.

hooks.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$FILE" in *.rs) rustfmt "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac

// ALTERNATIVE_CARGO: Use cargo fmt for workspace-aware formatting

hooks.command: FILE=$(cat | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path'); case "$FILE" in *.rs) cargo fmt -- "$FILE" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac
